sourceEvidence.title: Customer Quality Manager
sourceEvidence.quote:
* You are motivated by technology and quality, thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic setting, and use your strong analytical thinking and communication skills to foster positive relationships with stakeholders.
* Degree in engineering or related field and understanding of electronic devices (mandatory)
* Knowledge of semiconductor devices, package technologies, and device reliability (mandatory) with Failure analysis and field applications experienced highly desired.
* Experience with stress testing and structured problem-solving methods such as 8D (preferred)
* Familiarity with manufacturing engineering concepts, including process control, FMEA, and OCAP (preferred)
* Understanding of quality management systems and industry standards such as ISO 9001, IATF/VDA, and QMS (preferred)
* Strong communication skills with experience presenting technical information and supporting customers (mandatory)
* Ability to work effectively under pressure
